title: Fast Refresh had to perform a full reload

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/106832368/188202140-8736f3cf-df82-4d85-814c-4e7bdf554fa6.png)


### What browser are you using? (if relevant)

Google Chrome  102.0.5005.115

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

next run dev

### Describe the Bug

When data is sent to the service and a context that handles the entire application is updated, the system does not change the page but reloads itself, deleting everything in the provider (react)

### Expected Behavior

I hope you go to the next screen which is indicated by the router.push(urlRelative, url)

### Link to reproduction

/None

### To Reproduce

Is project in development

<sub>[NEXT-1355](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-1355/fast-refresh-had-to-perform-a-full-reload)</sub>
